name: Price Valuation 5
definition: Calculation of the net asset value for an investment fund/fund class.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique technical identifier for an instance of a price valuation within a price report, as assigned by the issuer of the report.

ValuationDateTime.name: Valuation Date Time
ValuationDateTime.definition: Date and time of the price valuation for the investment fund/fund class.

NAVDateTime.name: NAV Date Time
NAVDateTime.definition: Date and time at which a price is applied, according to the terms stated in the prospectus. The NAV date is also known as the trade date. The NAV date becomes the trade date in an order.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Investment fund class for which the net asset value is calculated.

TotalNAV.name: Total NAV
TotalNAV.definition: Value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, attributable to a specific investment fund class.

TotalUnitsNumber.name: Total Units Number
TotalUnitsNumber.definition: Total number of investment fund class units that have been issued.

NextValuationDateTime.name: Next Valuation Date Time
NextValuationDateTime.definition: Date and time of the next price valuation for the investment fund/fund class.

PreviousValuationDateTime.name: Previous Valuation Date Time
PreviousValuationDateTime.definition: Date and time of the previous price valuation for the investment fund/fund class.

ValuationType.name: Valuation Type
ValuationType.definition: Specifies how the valuation is done, based on the schedule stated in the prospectus.

OfficialValuationIndicator.name: Official Valuation Indicator
OfficialValuationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the valuation is an official valuation.

SuspendedIndicator.name: Suspended Indicator
SuspendedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the valuation of the investment fund class is suspended.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Amount of money for which goods or services are offered, sold, or bought.

ValuationStatistics.name: Valuation Statistics
ValuationStatistics.definition: Information related to the price variations of an investment fund class.

PerformanceDetails.name: Performance Details
PerformanceDetails.definition: Factors that give indications about the performance of a fund.

PriceDetailsRule.definition: If SuspendedIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then PriceDetails is optional.|If SuspendedIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), and if FinancialInstrumentDetails /DualFundIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then PriceDetails must be present at least once.|If SuspendedIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), and if FinancialInstrumentDetails /DualFundIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then PriceDetails must be present two or more times and PriceDetails/Type must be present with the values "BIDE" and "OFFR".
